company.shortDescription: SQUIRE is a barbershop business management system that includes tools for booking, scheduling, payment processing, and marketing management.
company.description: Squire is a booking and payment platform that connects people with barbers nationwide. With the SQUIRE app, users can easily find, book, and pay for haircuts or shaves, making the process quick and hassle-free. SQUIRE is recognized as one of the fastest-growing software technology platforms in the barbershop industry, which is valued at around a hundred billion dollars globally.
